sources.entry: Omeka - Create complex narratives and share rich collections, adhering to Dublin Core standards with Omeka on your server, designed for scholars, museums, libraries, archives, and enthusiasts. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Omeka is a PHP web publishing platform for building online exhibits and digital collections of items described with Dublin Core metadata.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly covers licensing: Omeka is distributed under the GNU GPL v3 and is copyright the Corporation for Digital Scholarship (2016-present) and the Roy Rosenzweig Center for History and New Media (2008-2016). It lists its bundled third-party components: Zend Framework, getID3, jQuery, jQuery UI, TinyMCE, and Silk Icons. The README does not describe features or setup steps. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as a way to create complex narratives and share rich collections on your own server, following Dublin Core standards, for scholars, museums, libraries, archives, and enthusiasts. The listing links a demo and the source code.
use_cases: build an online exhibit or narrative
self-host a museum or archive catalog
manage Dublin Core metadata for items
share a library or scholarly collection
notable: Organizes collections around Dublin Core metadata standards
Intended for scholars, museums, libraries, and archives
Bundles getID3 for media file handling
Released under GPL-3.0 with a free-software license
caveats: README gives no installation or usage instructions; see external release notes and documentation
README does not describe features in detail; capabilities here come from the awesome-selfhosted listing
Bundled third-party libraries carry their own licenses that must be complied with
